text: Good evening, I'm so sorry to be troubling you at this hour, I expect you have much more serious calls than mine. I'm looking after my granddaughter while her parents are away for a couple of nights. She's 10. Since yesterday one of her eyes has gone pink and it's sticky, especially when she woke up from her nap there was a crust on the lashes that I cleaned off with some warm water and cotton wool. I took her temperature just to be safe and it's 37.8, which I gather is only slightly up. She's otherwise herself, chatting away and watching her programmes. I just wasn't sure whether this is something that needs drops from the doctor or whether it clears on its own, and whether she ought to stay off school if it's still there on Monday. Her mother would normally know these things and I don't want to get it wrong. Thank you very much and apologies again
